g.text: Solid: HTTP / gRPC Dashed: Kafka CDC, callbacks, GitOps
Listing: CreateProduct (explicit qty) → Mongo outbox. Products never calls inventory or search.
Checkout: cart snapshot → CreateOrder → ReserveStock → hosted pay. Kafka is the reserve safety net and settlement.
Browse/seller list = search. PDP = products GetByID + inventory GetStock (pending vs zero vs error stay distinct).
No Hubble / Istio RED. Apps export OTLP traces; RED is Prometheus scrape not OTLP push.
